'''Masahiko Tanaka''' (Japanese: '''田中正彦''' ''Tanaka Masahiko'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Tanaka was born on October 1, 1954, in {{wp|Osaka}}, {{wp|Japan}}. As an adult, he became a voice actor for several anime series. He has occasionally provided his voice for {{aniseries|PTS}} since the [[original series]], and his best-known role was as the {{pkmn2|Legendary}} {{p|Suicune}}.
